scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Abundance in numerical dimension one for terminal threefolds in positive characteristic” (preprints/Abundance-in-numerical-dimension-one-for-terminal-threefolds-in-positive-characteristic-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 035 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5e170f2c29b7026e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let X be a normal projective Q-factorial threefold over an algebraically closed field k of characteristic p > 3. Suppose that X has terminal singularities and that KX is nef with ν(KX) = 1. Then some positive Cartier multiple of KX has at least two independent global sections. In particular, κ(X, KX) = 1 and KX is semiample.
